nodes.iskry.text.t: A spray of sparks shoots from the socket straight into your hand. You yell, and the machine flinches like a beast under the knife. "Patience," someone whispers inside your head. You can try again or rip it out by force.

nodes.powitanie.options.[wyjmij].text.t: Try to take the core out carefully.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: In the heart of the machine, between ribs of sheet metal, sits a cylinder of copper and glass. It pulses in a rhythm that seems familiar, though you've never heard it. It stinks of rust and burnt tallow.

nodes.sila.text.t: You rip the cylinder out along with a bundle of cables, with a crash that carries across the whole hill. Your hands burn, your ears ring, and the machine caves in on itself like a pricked bladder. The core lands in your bag, and you're as worn out as after a whole day's march through mud.

nodes.wyjety.text.t: Your fingers slip in between the ribs, and the core leaves its socket with a quiet, wet suck. The machine shudders but doesn't wake. You put the cylinder in your bag, and it weighs as much as a few coiled chains.

nodes.wyjmij.options.[w_cicho].text.t: Ease it out slowly, so as not to wake the machine.

nodes.wyjmij.text.t: The core sits in a socket of sheet metal and copper. Every move throws sparks.
